name: Korean Public API
tagline: Matches your product idea to the Korean government open APIs worth using
description: Describe what you are trying to build and it returns a short list of candidate public data services from Korea's government portals. Each pick is kept brief: why it fits the idea, what sort of key or registration stands in the way, where the official docs live, and a fallback if the first one disappoints.
author: Moon
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
